name: 21409 · Annapolis, MD
findings: ZIP 21409 (Annapolis) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21409 (Annapolis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
